question: A truck travels at a speed of 60 km/h from city P to city Q and returns to city P by the same route at a speed of 100 km/h. What is the average speed of the truck for the given journey?
solution:
**Given:**

A truck travels at a speed of 60 km/h from city P to city Q and returns to city P by the same route at a speed of 100 km/h.

**Concept:**

The average speed for a round trip is calculated using the harmonic mean of the speeds.
